notes.title: Release Date Set: July 19th!
notes.notes: [p][i]Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan[/i], Yuri Kissaten's upcoming free game, will release on July 19th! It's a short but powerful game about an important real-life issue, so please set aside 30 or 40 minutes to experience it.[/p][p][/p][p]You can learn more about the game by visiting its [url="https://yurikissaten.com/life-of-a-dispatch-english-teacher-in-japan-press-kit/"]press kit page[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]This may be an emotionally heavy game, but Yuri Kissaten also has plenty of much lighter, much cuter projects coming up in the extremely near future--stay tuned for those. In particular, our Kickstarter crowdfunding [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel/"]campaign for Winter Heat[/url] is drawing very near, and we'll be sharing more about it on this page soon as well.[/p][p][/p][p]Please get ready for [i]Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan,[/i] because it's just the first of many Yuri Kissaten events this summer.[/p]
